g.text: What it shows: Anthropic's own classification of what each conversation was for. This is the split that decides whether a

g.text: usage figure belongs in an enterprise demand estimate at all. 2026-05 data, with the change since 2026-04 marked.

g.text: Note: Only the work share is a candidate for an enterprise measure; personal and coursework use is real traffic but not commercial

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: workload. The three are mutually exclusive and total 100%. Claude.ai covers the Free, Pro and Max consumer plans plus Cowork;

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Anthropic's API traffic is a separate file and is not included here. A cell Anthropic did not publish is absent, not zero: a value is

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: released only where it clears an aggregation threshold and a geography sample floor.
